onboarding.title: Let's set up your company
onboarding.subtitle: Just one step. You can complete the rest in Settings.
onboarding.closedTitle: No account is linked to this number
onboarding.closedBody: Ask the company owner to invite your mobile number, then sign in again.

setup.title: The app is live — the database just needs connecting
setup.body: This deployment works but isn't connected to a Supabase project yet. Once the keys are added in Vercel, sign-in will work immediately.
setup.step1: Create a Supabase project (a region close to Saudi Arabia)
setup.step2: Add the keys in Vercel → Settings → Environment Variables
setup.step3: Redeploy, then sign in with your mobile number
